Name: TUTORIAL_PARAM_ST
Description: Tutorial pop-ups. A row is shown when the game requests it by ID (events, menus) or when a menu with a matching Trigger Menu opens; it needs its unlock flag on and, for a once-only row, not to have been seen. Rows can be a toast (small, closes on a timer) or a modal window (title, body and image; closes when dismissed). Modal rows also appear in a menu's Help list.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Parameters marked with  are excluded in the NT version package.

Fields.Name: Display Type
Fields.Description: How the tutorial is shown. 0: toast, one-line layout. 1: toast, multi-line layout. 100: modal window with image; it takes priority over a toast, which is closed and shown again afterwards. Other values: never shown. Only modal rows are listed in a menu's Help list.

Fields.Name: Trigger Menu
Fields.Description: Menu that shows this tutorial when it opens (it is queued along with every other row with the same value), and whose Help list includes it (modal rows only). 0: none, the tutorial only appears when requested by ID.

Fields.Name: Repeat Type
Fields.Description: Number of times a tutorial can be displayed

Fields.Name: Show in Help List
Fields.Description: Set: the entry can appear in the Guide/Handbook lists. Retail: set on every Guide and Handbook entry, clear on plain tutorial pop-ups.

Fields.Name: Unknown Flag
Fields.Description: Its use is not established. Retail: set on all but one Handbook entry and on most Guide entries of categories 10 and 20.

Fields.Name: Handbook Entry
Fields.Description: Set: the entry belongs to the Handbook and is left out of the Guide list. Retail: set on exactly the Handbook categories (110, 120, 140).

Fields.Name: Image ID
Fields.Description: Picture shown in the modal window. 0: no picture. Toasts don't show it.

Fields.Name: Unlock Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that must be on for the tutorial to show (requests are ignored while it's off). 0 or -1: always allowed. In a Help list, a row is listed only while this flag is on.

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: Text of the tutorial: the title is TutorialTitle and the body is TutorialBody, both with this ID.

Fields.Name: Minimum Display Time
Fields.Description: Toast only: when the toast is closed early, it stays on screen until it has been shown for at least this long (seconds).

Fields.Name: Display Time
Fields.Description: Toast only: the toast closes by itself after this many seconds.

Fields.Name: Tutorial Category ID
Fields.Description: TutorialCategoryParam row this tutorial is listed under in the help list. Retail: 10, 20, 30, 110, 120, 140; 255 on the plain pop-up tutorials, which are not listed.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Unknown (List Order?)
Fields.Description: No reader located. Retail: a number unique to each Guide/Handbook entry, grouped by category, that looks like a list order (Handbook 101-610, Guide 1000-1174 and 10100-10800); 255 on plain tutorial pop-ups.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.
